scope: Fresh isolated regression rehearsal using temporary SQLite and actual HTTP/API/lifespan workflow. No hardware, serial port, credentials, production database or remote migration is used.
test_command: import sys; sys.modules['readline']=None; import pytest; raise SystemExit(pytest.main(sys.argv[1:]))

checks.name: Calibration offset cannot be credited as physical repair
checks.assertion: CAL-A/CAL-B equivalent fixture retains unchanged raw 50 C but changes calibrated 50 to 46 C; verification is insufficient_evidence and actual incident closure route rejects stale improvement.

checks.name: Immutable configuration remains attached to the acquisition
checks.assertion: Editing current limits creates a different config_id; existing frame/history thresholds and load interpretation remain unchanged; enabling load under the old acquisition configuration returns 423.

checks.name: Accepted acquisition survives analysis failure and startup recovery
checks.assertion: Injected processing interruption leaves accepted frame and pending analysis; a real application lifespan restart without another packet completes analysis and latches the decision without creating any relay command, even with automatic-cutoff settings enabled in the isolated fixture.

limitations: All measured-source packets are explicitly constructed software test fixtures, not a live hardware recording.
This rehearsal validates application behavior and recovery, not transformer calibration, electrical safety, cloud trigger execution or fleet-scale capacity.
Startup recovery is bounded to 100 pending jobs and never operates hardware.
